rows.title: Bounded empty-response recovery repair
rows.summary: Limit how many times the agent retries after getting empty responses, to stop it from looping forever.
rows.value_headline: Harness failure prevented evaluation; trace still shows bounded recovery churn without a valid patch/eval reward.

rows.title: Structured action contract for tool args
rows.summary: Force the agent to follow a strict format when calling tools, so it stops sending garbled instructions.
rows.value_headline: One-task rollout aborted by provider JSON parsing failure before patch publication or evaluation.

rows.title: No-patch control with bounded retries
rows.summary: Add a retry limit for when the agent finishes without producing any code changes, to prevent wasted compute.
rows.value_headline: Two one-task attempts hit provider JSON decode failures; no result.json or patch reward to rank.

rows.title: Hard finalization diff gate
rows.summary: Refuse to let the agent finish unless it can prove it actually edited source files.
rows.value_headline: Block finish unless a tracked source diff exists and patch_bytes > 0.

rows.title: Explicit ready-to-finish graph state
rows.summary: Make the agent pass through a checklist before it can declare done, so it can't skip writing code.
rows.value_headline: Use an explicit graph state to gate termination on patch confirmation.

rows.title: Forced source-edit checkpoint
rows.summary: Pause the agent right after it writes scratch files and redirect it to edit the actual source code instead.
rows.value_headline: Checkpoint immediately after scratch-file writes to redirect the agent to tracked `src/` edits.

rows.title: Patch-confirmed finalization latch
rows.summary: Lock the finish button until the agent confirms it has real code changes to show.
rows.value_headline: Block finish until a tracked src diff and compact changed-files summary are confirmed.

rows.title: Structured finalization schema
rows.summary: Require the agent to fill out a form proving it made real edits before it can submit its answer.
rows.value_headline: Require structured finalization fields so the agent cannot hand-wave a finish without tracked-diff evidence.

rows.title: Persistent tracked-src-edit state
rows.summary: Remember whether the agent has edited source files yet, and block it from finishing until it has.
rows.value_headline: Keep a durable has_tracked_src_edit state that routes away from scratch writes until source edits exist.

rows.title: Ready-to-finish graph state
rows.summary: Add a separate 'ready to finish' step the agent must pass, checking that code was actually changed.
rows.value_headline: Add an explicit ready_to_finish state gated by patch confirmation and tracked diff.

rows.title: Checkpointed finalization resume
rows.summary: Save the agent's progress after code edits so it can pick up from there instead of starting over.
rows.value_headline: Use persistence and interrupts so clean-diff runs resume from an edit-confirmation checkpoint.

rows.title: Third-iteration source-edit checkpoint
rows.summary: After three rounds of work, force the agent to show what files it changed before it can wrap up.
rows.value_headline: Force a diff summary and changed-file count after iteration 3 before any final answer path.

rows.title: Block untracked file writes and inject tracked-path sed guidance
rows.summary: Stop the agent from writing to random files and guide it to edit only the right source code.
rows.value_headline: Block the dominant no-patch failure path by constraining write_file to tracked paths only. First-ever non-zero patch_bytes (1591) after 17 prior hypotheses all produced patch_bytes=0.

rows.title: Add edit_file tool with line-range editing
rows.summary: Add a structured edit_file tool so the agent can make surgical edits to source files without sed/cat, making source editing easier than appending tests.
rows.value_headline: edit_file tool enabled the agent to produce a correct source fix (resolved=true) vs H0022 baseline which only appended tests (resolved=false). Agent used edit_file 3x, never wrote tests.

rows.title: Auto-indent preservation in edit_file
rows.summary: When edit_file replaces lines that have leading whitespace but the replacement text doesn't, automatically inherit the original indentation to prevent accidental dedent.
rows.value_headline: Fixed indentation stripping bug in edit_file: H0023 produced wrong-indent patch (resolved=false) on astropy-14309; H0024 auto-inherits original indentation → resolved=true. Three-task gate: 3/3 resolved after fix.

rows.title: Workspace context in user message to eliminate /repo path assumption
rows.summary: Add workspace_root and current_directory to the user message so the agent knows its working directory from iteration 1, eliminating 2-3 wasted iterations on path discovery.
rows.value_headline: Eliminate 2-3 wasted iterations per run by adding workspace_root and CWD to user message. Agent goes straight to rg/read_file instead of cd /repo. 40% iteration reduction on astropy-13033 (40→24 iters).

rows.title: Read-search loop detection and intervention
rows.summary: Track consecutive read/search actions without any edit. After 5 consecutive reads, append a reminder to tool output prompting the agent to edit files. Breaks read-search loops that waste iteration budget.
rows.value_headline: Edit tracker breaks read-search loops: astropy-13033 UNRESOLVED→RESOLVED, astropy-13398 100→57 iters (no GraphRecursionError crash), astropy-13236 14→8 iters.

rows.title: Strategy prompt refinement for better edit quality
rows.summary: Refine system prompt to encourage multi-edit fixes and edit verification. REJECTED: caused regression on astropy-13033 (resolved=true→false). Minimal edit strategy works better with this model.
rows.value_headline: REGRESSION: 'identify ALL locations' instruction causes over-editing. astropy-13033 resolved=true→false. Minimal edit strategy produces better patches with this model.

rows.title: Fix reminder messages to reference edit_file instead of sed -i
rows.summary: Update all reminder messages to reference edit_file instead of sed -i/write_file. REJECTED: no Pareto improvement on batch gate — resolved count flat at 3/6, mixed trace health results.
rows.value_headline: No Pareto improvement: resolved 3/6 flat. astropy-13236 improved (7 vs 52 iters) but 13033 and 13398 regressed. Reminder text alignment alone insufficient.
